note: Call-type rules as data. Synthetic prototype. Legal and Compliance own this file; wording of regulations was checked against eCFR on 2026-10-08 (see docs/HUMANA_CONTEXT.md) and must be re-checked by Compliance before any real use.

tpmo_sales.label: Sales or marketing call by a third-party marketing organization (TPMO)
tpmo_sales.recording: All marketing and sales calls recorded and kept 6 years: audio in years 1 to 3, audio or a complete transcript in years 4 to 6.

telephonic_enrollment.label: Telephonic enrollment by the plan
required_steps: Review the Pre-Enrollment Checklist contents before completing enrollment
Say where the Summary of Benefits can be accessed
telephonic_enrollment.recording: Check plan enrollment guidance; not assumed to follow the TPMO rule.

member_service.label: Ordinary plan member-service call
member_service.recording: No blanket recording rule found; the call may create regulated records (grievance, appeal, coverage determination). Keep recording and business-record retention separate.
